summary: The diff implements String.prototype.concat following the spec steps in order. RequireObjectCoercible(this) and ToString(this) run first, then for each argument ToString(next) runs before the concatenation, and every fallible call uses `?`. Each spec step is kept as a comment above its code. The only other change is renaming the unused `new_target` parameter to `_new_target`, which the removed `let _ = (...)` line made necessary. No special-casing, hardcoded values, swallowed errors or made-up returns. I could not verify the helper names (agent.concat, push_root, with_roots, pop_roots, ops::require_object_coercible) from the diff alone; the build passing suggests they exist.
notes_for_next_attempt: Looks correct as is. Optional check: the `?` inside the with_roots closure skips the `pop_roots(mark)` call on error. That is harmless only if with_roots restores the root-stack length on exit, so confirm that in the with_roots implementation. No change to the diff is required on the basis of this review.
